data.name: Mudrika
data.gender_notes: Mudrika is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mudrika means 'one who frequently praises God'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'madhkara' which means 'praising'. The name Mudrika carries the meaning “Praising God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Mudrika usually hope their child will grow to embody praising god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: This name carries a spiritual significance, as it symbolizes constant remembrance and worship of the Divine.
data.etymology: Mudrika belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praising God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mudrika total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مُدْرِك
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُدَرِك هو اسم علم عربي مشتق من الجذر ركّ-م-د، يُشير إلى المُدرِكين المُعلمين والمُتَألّمين، والمُدَرّيكين الرؤوفين والرؤوفات. يعد مُدريك من أسماء الشخصية الشائعة في الثقافة العربية الإسلامية، والذي يشير إلى الفرد ذو الصبر والاستقامة، والمتميز بالعلم والمعرفة.

in_urdu.name: مُدریک
in_urdu.meaning: علم ودانش کے مالک، ممتاز ہونے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مُدریک ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا تعلق رک-م-د جڑ سے ہے۔ اس کا معنی ہے علم ودانش کا مالک اور ممتاز ہونے والا۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں ایک اہم مقام رکھتا ہے اور اسے عربی اور اردو میں بڑی تعداد میں استعمال کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुद्रिक
in_hindi.meaning: ज्ञान और बुद्धि का मालिक, उत्तम प्रतिष्ठा वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुद्रिक एक अरबी नाम है जिसका संबंध रक्-म-द जड़ से है। इसका अर्थ है ज्ञान और बुद्धि का मालिक और उत्तम प्रतिष्ठा वाला। यह नाम हिंदी में भी इस्तेमाल किया जाता है और यह भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है।

in_pashto.name: مدرک
in_pashto.long_meaning: مدرک پښتو نوم دی چې په اصل کې عربي نوم دی، له رک-م-د رګڅه څخه راغلی دی. دا نوم به پښتنو کورو کې تر ټولو ښه نومونو پورې ښیږي چې د علم او دانشمندۍ څخه سره په ګډه لېږدول کېږي.

in_english.name: Mudrika
in_english.meaning: conqueror of knowledge, learned, and of noble character
in_english.long_meaning: Mudrika is an Arabic given name derived from the root R-K-M-D. It refers to the conqueror of knowledge, the learned, and the noble character. In Islamic tradition, Mudrika is associated with the qualities of patience, perseverance, and intelligence. It is a popular name in many Muslim cultures and is often given to children born into families of high social status.

Overall, Mudrika is a beautiful and meaningful name that reflects a deep spiritual connection to Allah and a commitment to living a pious and devoted life.
